name: Xinkgo Demo: Full
description: A tour of every capability Xinkgo fully supports: commands, data, notices, Vault and Editor read/write, workspace.openLinkText, requestUrl, app events, ribbon and status items, and a real plugin-owned ItemView surface. APIs the host only records or fakes are deliberately absent. C3 because the view is a DOM-level surface that runs in the plugin's own WebView page.
author: Xinkgo
